rule: PREREG_R7 5.5 / 5.6: 23 incumbent episodes (round 6's 5.5): m_F(f) = float64 mean of f's 10 phase-F consensus AUCs; m_P_fresh = float64 mean of the incumbent's phase-F consensus AUCs over its ok, non-flagged runs (>= 8 required, else +inf); f replaces P iff (a) f has 10 ok, non-flagged phase-F runs, (b) own-input SP-SR = MP-SR = 1 in >= 8 of them and (c) m_F(f) >= max(m_P_frozen, m_P_fresh) + 0.01 (exact floats); otherwise P stays. 7 STRICT episodes: a finalist is confirmed iff it has 10 ok, non-flagged phase-F runs and own-input SP-SR = MP-SR = 1 in >= 8 of them; pick = rank 1 if confirmed, else rank 2 if confirmed; if neither: among the finalists with >= 8 ok, non-flagged runs, more SP=MP=1 runs, then higher m_F, then phase-S rank (marked unconfirmed); if none has >= 8 ok runs, the episode halts. S7 = per episode the 5.5 result; trial t is complete for a set iff every episode's job has an ok, non-flagged run t; R7-CLOSEST = the complete S7 trial whose 30-episode mean own-input AUC is closest to the mean over the complete S7 trials (ties: smaller distance of its consensus-B mean to the mean of that quantity, then lower t). REF6 (S7 with the 7 STRICT jobs replaced by their round-6 references) and Delta_B are report only.
upload_eligibility: R7-CLOSEST (trial 2 of S7) is the upload-eligible Tier-2 file under the STRICT standard (PREREG_R7 5.6)
